messages.subject: Re-deploy problem: 502 bad Gateway
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to redeploy a shinyapp that I had running a few months ago.  Everything runs fine locally (tested with runApp() ), however when I use deployApp("path/to/app") i get the following:

> deployApp("./joyceLab_datasets")
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...Error: /v1/applications/17833/upload 502 - <html>
<head><title>502 Bad Gateway</title></head>
<body bgcolor="white">
<center><h1>502 Bad Gateway</h1></center>
<hr><center>nginx/1.4.2</center>
</body>
</html>

Is it me, or the server?

Thank you for any help you can offer,
Bobby
